tasks.title: cli: root normalize_plan's existing-test glob at the brief's external working_dir (NGv2 gap #4 / prop 3/3)
acceptance_criteria: harness/planner/cli.py defines a NEW top-level function _effective_repo_root(brief_obj) returning Path(brief_obj.working_dir) when working_dir is a non-empty str that is NOT _target_is_self, else Path.cwd(). It uses harness.paths._target_is_self and pathlib.Path.

_effective_repo_root handles: external non-self working_dir -> Path(working_dir); None/empty/whitespace working_dir -> Path.cwd(); working_dir pointing at the JM repo itself (self) -> Path.cwd(); brief_obj missing the working_dir attribute -> Path.cwd().

cli.main's leaf-pipeline normalize call is rewired from `normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=Path.cwd())` to `normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=_effective_repo_root(brief_obj))` (so an external child plan's impl vcmd maps to the EXTERNAL repo's tests/**). No other line of main changes; persist_plan, validate_plan, and the exit codes are byte-identical.
The committed oracle tests/planner/test_effective_repo_root.py passes 5/5 and tests/planner/test_cli.py and tests/planner/test_sanitize_vcmd_repo_mapping.py still pass.

spec.objective: Close NobleGreedv2 gap #4 (epic auto-decompose, working_dir propagation 3/3): cli.main calls normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=Path.cwd()), so for an EXTERNAL child plan the normalizer globs JM's tests/** (miss) and the impl verification_command is mangled to a JM-rooted smoke import instead of running the external repo's own oracle. Introduce a tiny helper that resolves the effective glob root from the brief's working_dir and wire it into that single call. normalize_plan already accepts and honors repo_root (proven by tests/planner/test_sanitize_vcmd_repo_mapping.py); only the call site needs the external root.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW top-level function _effective_repo_root(brief_obj) -> pathlib.Path: read wd = getattr(brief_obj, 'working_dir', None); if isinstance(wd, str) and wd and not _target_is_self(wd): return Path(wd); else return Path.cwd().

_target_is_self is imported from harness.paths (e.g. `from harness.paths import _target_is_self` at the top of the helper or module-level). Path is already imported in cli.py (`from pathlib import Path`).

In cli.main, change ONLY the normalize_plan call from `normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=Path.cwd())` to `normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=_effective_repo_root(brief_obj))`. brief_obj is already in scope at that point in main.
spec.interfaces: New: harness/planner/cli.py::_effective_repo_root(brief_obj) -> pathlib.Path. Unchanged: cli.main signature and the normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=...) signature. _target_is_self(working_dir) lives in harness/paths.py and returns True for absent/self/inside-repo paths, False for a genuinely external path.
edge_cases: brief_obj.working_dir = None or '' or '   ' -> returns Path.cwd().
brief_obj.working_dir = str(Path.cwd()) (self) -> returns Path.cwd() (because _target_is_self is True).
brief_obj has no working_dir attribute -> getattr default None -> returns Path.cwd().
non_goals: Do not change normalize_plan, persist_plan, or any other symbol's behaviour; only add _effective_repo_root and rewire the single normalize call in main.
Do not change main's control flow, exit codes, or any other line.
Do not use eval, exec, or __import__.
Do not add integration tests; the helper is covered by the committed unit oracle and the wiring by the existing cli/sanitize suites.
spec.implementation_notes:
Emit a __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ block with TWO kind:'symbol' partial-edit patches (both small top-level functions, no class methods, no AST-truncation risk):

(1) R-ANCHOR the new helper as a TRAILING top-level def riding on the existing small function `_brief_slug`. The patch for name '_brief_slug' re-emits _brief_slug UNCHANGED, then appends the new function immediately after it:

    def _effective_repo_root(brief_obj):
        # NGv2 gap #4: root the normalizer's existing-test glob at the brief's
        # EXTERNAL working_dir (an epic-generated child plan targets the external
        # repo) instead of JM's cwd, so the impl vcmd maps to the external repo's
        # own oracle. Self / empty / missing working_dir keeps the JM cwd root.
        from harness.paths import _target_is_self
        wd = getattr(brief_obj, 'working_dir', None)
        if isinstance(wd, str) and wd and not _target_is_self(wd):
            return Path(wd)
        return Path.cwd()

(2) A partial-edit of `main` that changes ONLY the line
    final_plan = normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=Path.cwd())
to
    final_plan = normalize_plan(final_plan, repo_root=_effective_repo_root(brief_obj))
and leaves every other line of main byte-identical (the import of normalize_plan on the preceding line stays). If re-emitting main risks drift, keep its body verbatim except that one line.
